name: io.github.howardchenghuang-dotcom/askfur
title: AskFur pet devices (pre-launch)
description: Browse AskFur's pre-launch connected pet devices and essentials; join the launch waitlist.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: AskFur's pre-launch catalogue of connected pet devices and essentials for cats and dogs: name, tagline, category, stage (concept or launched) and page link. Concept products are previews, not for sale.

category.description: Only this category: device (connected devices) or essential (everyday gear). Leave out for all products.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full public details of one product: description, highlights, confirmed specs, planned app features and customisation. Concept products have no price or delivery date because none is confirmed.

slug.description: Product slug from list_products, for example the last part of its page link.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Adds the person's own email to AskFur's launch-updates waitlist. Only call after the person has agreed. Nothing is bought and no email is sent now. Returns a private removal code the person can use on askfur.com/preview to leave the list.

email.description: The person's own email address, which they asked to add. Never someone else's.

product.description: What they want updates about: a product slug from list_products, or general for the whole brand. Defaults to general.

consent.description: Must be true: the person agreed to receive AskFur launch updates by email at this address.
